text: This is another shopping mall along Ramintra Road with a wide variety of goods. While the different zones might be slightly separated, they are still within walking distance of each other. There are also gas stations, beauty salons, and a diverse selection of restaurants offering various menus, including Thai-style dishes, rice porridge, seafood, and the famous Sukiyaki Teenoi. The mall has ample space to accommodate families, groups of friends, and tour groups. There is also plenty of convenient parking for both tour groups and private vehicles. For public transportation, there are buses, taxis, motorcycle taxis, and the Pink Line BTS Skytrain. Get off at station 24 Ramintra Km. 9 (Sinpaet Ramintra Hospital) and take a motorcycle taxi or taxi a short distance to reach The Alley Ramintra.

This gas station has a huge variety of food and other items, making it quite convenient and great for grabbing a bite to eat 😆

I initially stopped by for a quick meal at Tee Noi (forgot to take a picture), then I ended up trying other general dishes. My most frequent stops are probably the Tom Yum noodles and the "Happiness Drinks" shop.

Many of the food stalls are delicious and suit my taste. Parking is convenient right in front of the shops; I've never had to park elsewhere because I always find a spot nearby. It's very convenient.

Upon arrival, you'll find a Starbucks and Bellini's bakery. The supermarket is a Tops supermarket, and there are a variety of restaurants offering Thai and Japanese cuisine.
